title: Quick-fix Garlicky Indian Bryndza Cheese Biryani
description: A quick and indulgent Bengali dish featuring molten Bryndza cheese and a hint of garlic, all wrapped up in a tender agave leaf package.
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat. Clean and prepare 4 agave leaves for steaming. Cut the bryndza cheese into 4 equal pieces. Peel and mince the ginger and garlic. Mix the cumin seeds, coriander seeds, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl. Place a bryndza cheese piece on each agave leaf, followed by a sprinkle of the spice mixture, a pinch of ginger, and a clove of garlic. Fold the agave leaves to enclose the cheese and spices, securing with a toothpick if needed. Grill the cheese packages for 4-6 minutes on each side, until the cheese is melted and the agave leaves are tender. Serve immediately, garnished with additional garlic if desired.
